verses: I was putting my clothes on upside down, Before the eastern sky was clear. I was putting my clothes on upside down, When a call to the court came here.
I was putting my clothes on upside down, Ere showed the east the rising flame. I was putting my clothes on upside down, When from the court an order came.
On garden fence, made but of willow wands, E'en reckless fellows look with fear. Our prince can't tell the night from dawn;— Too soon, or late, his calls appear!
